messages:
maria_chen: Quick design sync 2: chart unit behavior + smoothing for 'Latency by Route' panel. Should axis show ms always, or switch to s when large? Also need a default for smoothing and an outlier handling pattern.
kevin_wang: I vote auto-switch: if max >= 2000ms display in seconds with 1 decimal, else ms. Keeps labels clean.
samir_a: Frontend can do that. Need a deterministic rule in the schema so tests pass.
elsa_viz: UX: prefer explicit affordance for smoothing. Default off; users can toggle "Smoothing" which shows method (moving avg 3). For legends: inline up to 4 series, else collapse into "+N" menu.
toni_access: Accessibility: when unit changes (ms -> s) we must announce via aria-live and tooltip must include full numeric precision for screen readers.
maria_chen: Proposed rule: axis_unit = ms if max < 2000, otherwise s (1 decimal). Smoothing default = off, toggle label "Smoothing 1 moving avg"? maybe clearer text. Outlier policy: visual clamp at 99th percentile with visible indicator.
kevin_wang: Copy suggestion: "Smoothing — moving average (3-sample window)" so users know the window. For clamp tooltip: "Note: values above the 99th percentile are hidden for readability; see raw table for full values."
samir_a: Dev notes: we'll implement a visualization-only clamp: data stays unchanged. Frontend will expose an icon at the axis when clamp applied. Add a test fixture where a single spike is 10x median to validate.
elsa_viz: Example panel schema for eng:
```json
{"axis_unit_rule":"auto_ms_to_s","unit_threshold_ms":2000,"smoothing_default":false,"smoothing_window":3,"legend_max_inline":4,"outlier_clamp_percentile":99}
```
kevin_wang: Slight schema note: use booleans/numbers not strings for thresholds.
toni_access: Accessibility checklist for PR: 1) smoothing toggle keyboard focusable and has aria-pressed/role=switch 2) aria-live region for unit changes 3) legend collapse should be operable as a listbox for keyboard users 4) clamp indicator must be focusable with role=button and tooltip accessible.
maria_chen: Action items: Kevin - finalize microcopy for toggle + clamp tooltip. Elsa - open schema PR with mock images. Samir - add clamp UI + tests. Toni - review ARIA on PR. I'll update docs after PRs land. :thumbsup: 
kevin_wang: Will send copy + example by EOD.
elsa_viz: Opening PR in morning with screenshots.
samir_a: Starting implementation today, will ping if edge cases show perf issues.
toni_access: Happy to review the accessibility bits.
maria_chen: Thanks everyone. Closing when PRs are opened.
